method.engine: PostgreSQL 17, psql subprocess, Python standard library
method.data: TP4 supplied dump + cumulative TP4/TP5 additions; prior rows retained; 25000 synthetic current-day orders and 100000 details added separately
method.cache: Warm database cache, no cache flushing
method.session_prefix_sql: SET max_parallel_workers_per_gather=0; SET jit=off; SET default_transaction_isolation='read committed'; SET timezone='America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires';
method.text_plan_capture: One additional real EXPLAIN TEXT execution per query, outside the five measured JSON runs
method.compatibility: Inherited TIMESTAMPTZ uses local-day range; detail has generated subtotal, composite key and no soft-delete column; no state filter is added

views.definition:
SELECT lote_responsable.lote_id,
    responsable_deposito.deposito_id,
    lote_responsable.responsable_control_id
   FROM (lote_responsable
     JOIN responsable_deposito USING (responsable_control_id));

SELECT d.pedido_id,
    d.producto_id,
    pr.nombre AS producto_nombre,
    d.cantidad,
    d.precio_unitario,
    d.subtotal
   FROM (detalle_pedido d
     JOIN producto pr ON ((pr.id = d.producto_id)));

SELECT p.id AS pedido_id,
    p.fecha,
    p.forma_pago,
    p.estado,
    p.total,
    u.id AS usuario_id,
    u.nombre AS usuario_nombre,
    u.apellido AS usuario_apellido,
    u.email,
    u.telefono
   FROM (pedido p
     JOIN usuario u ON ((u.id = p.usuario_id)))
  WHERE ((p.eliminado = false) AND (u.eliminado = false));

SELECT pr.id AS producto_id,
    pr.nombre AS producto_nombre,
    pr.descripcion,
    pr.precio,
    pr.stock,
    c.id AS categoria_id,
    c.nombre AS categoria_nombre
   FROM (producto pr
     JOIN categoria c ON ((c.id = pr.categoria_id)))
  WHERE ((pr.eliminado = false) AND (c.eliminado = false));

materialized_views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS categoria_id,
    c.nombre AS categoria_nombre,
    date_trunc('month'::text, p.fecha) AS mes,
    count(DISTINCT p.id) AS cantidad_pedidos,
    sum(d.cantidad) AS unidades,
    (sum(d.subtotal))::numeric(16,2) AS facturacion
   FROM (((categoria c
     JOIN producto pr ON ((pr.categoria_id = c.id)))
     JOIN detalle_pedido d ON ((d.producto_id = pr.id)))
     JOIN pedido p ON ((p.id = d.pedido_id)))
  WHERE ((p.eliminado = false) AND (p.estado <> 'CANCELADO'::estado_pedido))
  GROUP BY c.id, c.nombre, (date_trunc('month'::text, p.fecha));

SELECT ((ped.fecha AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires'::text))::date AS fecha,
    c.nombre AS categoria,
    sum(dp.subtotal) AS total_vendido
   FROM (((detalle_pedido dp
     JOIN producto pr ON ((pr.id = dp.producto_id)))
     JOIN categoria c ON ((c.id = pr.categoria_id)))
     JOIN pedido ped ON ((ped.id = dp.pedido_id)))
  WHERE (ped.eliminado = false)
  GROUP BY (((ped.fecha AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires'::text))::date), c.nombre;
